messages:
oliver: Heads-up — the localized site build (Docusaurus) for `/docs/ja/` is failing in CI. Lots of 404s for images that used to be relative paths.

sarah: Saw the same in staging this morning. Seems specific to pages migrated from mkdocs where images were `../assets/img/...`.

carmen: any stack traces or a failing linkcheck output?

oliver: CI excerpt: 
```
LinkChecker: ERROR http://site.internal/docs/ja/getting-started/assets/logo.png 404 Not Found
WARNING: Found 20 broken image links in /docs/ja/**
```

ben: I noticed Docusaurus v3 changed how `static` files are resolved in localized routes. Relative image references inside translated markdown can be resolved incorrectly if the base path isn't normalized.

alice: Quick idea: convert image references to absolute doc-relative paths at build time, or update frontmatter `slug` so the generated path matches the file layout. Either is OK but need a script and a small PR.

carmen: I can whip up a simple pre-build sanitizer that rewrites `![alt](../assets/` to `![alt](/docs/assets/` for the ja locale only. But I'd prefer a targeted regex rather than global replace.

ben: Please add a test run locally: `yarn workspace site build --locale ja` then `npx linkinator ./build/ja -p 5` — catches these quickly.

oliver: @carmen go ahead. Small reminder: we should keep hash/anchor links intact, and not touch code block examples.

carmen: Draft script in this thread: 
```
# replace only image links in docs/ja/**/*.md that start with ../assets
find docs/ja -name "*.md" -print0 | xargs -0 sed -E -i '' 's|!\[([^\]]*)\]\(\.\./assets/([^\)]+)\)|![\1](/docs/assets/\2)|g'
```

alice: nit: use cross-platform `perl -0777 -pe` or node script — mac `sed -i ''` differs. But for CI, a node script is safest.

doc-bot: PR opened: `docs: fix ja image paths (carmen)` — checks started.

deploy-bot: CI status: build failed on `link-check` step — 12 broken images remain.

ben: Looks like some pages use `../../assets/` (two levels). Carmen, can you include both cases in the patch? Also include a small unit test that reads a temp file and ensures replacements are correct.

carmen: Will do. Also adding a README note for future migrations describing the mapping.

oliver: For the release notes, mention the Docusaurus v3 basePath behavior so writers don't reintroduce relative references.

alice: After patch, I'll run the `linkinator` pass and manual spot-check on a few pages. If green, we can merge and trigger staging deploy.

carmen: pushed update — now handles `../` and `../../` cases and uses node. PTAL: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/3129

doc-bot: PR build: link-check step passed. Visual diff flagged one image moved to `/docs/assets/old-logo.png` — reviewer needed.

ben: I can review later today. Quick check: ensure images with computed paths (templating) are skipped.

oliver: Thanks everyone. Once merged, can ops roll the localized site? I'll coordinate with marketing for the ja launch.

deploy-bot: Staging deploy finished at 1945679520 — all localized pages returned 200 for images.

sarah: verified a handful of pages on staging, looks good :thumbsup:. Close the TODO in the migration guide when you have a moment, @carmen.

carmen: Will update the migration guide and add a short script usage example. Done — closing thread.
